decisions.title: Dual MySQL + MongoDB storage for Watchlist and PF
decisions.rationale: MySQL for structured queries and reporting; MongoDB for flexible document storage and supplementary metadata.

decisions.title: Custom JWT middleware instead of ASP.NET Core Identity
decisions.rationale: Session-based token storage + custom role resolution from MySQL user_group tables.

decisions.title: BaseRepository pattern for all data access
decisions.rationale: Centralizes MySQL connection management and stored procedure execution. All repositories extend BaseRepository.

decisions.title: RiskV2 replaces Risk for active risk scoring
decisions.rationale: RiskV2 adds Senior Management override capability with audit trail. Both exist but V2 is the active version.

decisions.title: C6 external API gated by CallC6Screening flag
decisions.rationale: Allows toggling external paid screening on/off. When off, local Screening API (localhost:5010) is used.

decisions.title: EPPlus for dynamic Excel template generation
decisions.rationale: Replaced static Excel templates with EPPlus-generated templates that include data validation dropdowns, synchronized with manual entry UI.

decisions.title: Case status=4 forces read-only in Process.cshtml
decisions.rationale: When case is submitted to Senior Management (status 4), all inputs are disabled. Compliance Officers can view but not modify.
